newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse trade, index end week down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse trade, index end week down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index ended the week down 0.6 percent points in lower trade compared to its level at the end of last week, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 556.41 on Friday from 559.76 a week earlier.
Volume traded during the week was 3.40 million dinars against 22.19 million dinars.
Focus was on Banque Nationale Agricole with the exchange of 30,619 shares at the unchanged price of 33.8 dinars per share on news that the bank was to recover a 980 million dinars bad debt.
Banque du Sud fell during the week three percent to 25.32 dinars. UIB bank eased 0.34 percent to 11.5 dinars. Banque de Tunisie declined 0.08 perecent to 75 dinars.
STB bank was up 1.68 percent to 21.73 dinars.
